}}'''''Thief Simulator''''' is an [[open-world]] [[Stealth game|stealth]] video game developed by Polish developer Noble Muffins and released for [[Microsoft Windows]] on November 9, 2018, for [[Nintendo Switch]] on May 16, 2019, for [[PlayStation 4]] on August 12, 2020, and for the [[Quest 2]] on July 8, 2022.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2019/05/nintendo_download_16th_may_north_america |title=Nintendo Download: 16th May (North America) |website=[[Nintendo Life]] |first=Darren |last=Calvert |date=May 16, 2019 |accessdate=April 25, 2020 |archive-date=May 1, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220501215702/https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2019/05/nintendo_download_16th_may_north_america |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2019/05/nintendo_download_16th_may_europe |title=Nintendo Download: 16th May (Europe) |website=[[Nintendo Life]] |first=Anthony |last=Dickens |date=May 16, 2019 |accessdate=April 25, 2020 |archive-date=April 25, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220425124344/https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2019/05/nintendo_download_16th_may_europe |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Feltham |first=Jamie |date=June 27, 2022 |title=Thief Simulator VR Headed To Quest Soon |url=https://uploadvr.com/thief-simulator-vr-headed-to-quest-soon/ |access-date=August 8, 2022 |language=en-US |archive-date=August 8, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220808090419/https://uploadvr.com/thief-simulator-vr-headed-to-quest-soon/ |url-status=live }}</ref>  A sequel to the game, ''Thief Simulator 2'', was released in October 4, 2023.<ref>{{cite web |title=Thief Simulator 2 |url=https://www.gamepressure.com/games/thief-simulator-2/z25f3d |website=Game Pressure |access-date=27 December 2025}}</ref>

==Synopsis==
The player assumes the role of an unnamed thief, who works for the Lombardi [[crime family]] after they paid his bail, guided by Vinny to commit crimes. At the end of the game's original story, Vinny attempts to kill the thief with a mail bomb, but fails. In a later update, the thief traverses the industrial district's buildings to steal evidence implicating the Lombardis and explosive constituents. He then stashes the evidence in the garage and the explosive charge in the office before setting it off. Vinny is presumably killed as the mansion explodes.
